panels.title: Object 이벤트 수
panels.description: 선택한 범위에서 발생한 object 단위 sync 이벤트 수

targets.query: event_type:container_sync_object AND host:${host:raw} AND account:${account:raw} AND container:${container:raw} AND NOT host:knu-tst1

panels.title: PUT 성공 수
panels.description: 선택한 범위에서 성공한 PUT 복제 수

targets.query: event_type:container_sync_object AND outcome:success AND method:PUT AND host:${host:raw} AND account:${account:raw} AND container:${container:raw} AND NOT host:knu-tst1

panels.title: DELETE 성공 수
panels.description: 선택한 범위에서 성공한 DELETE 복제 수

targets.query: event_type:container_sync_object AND outcome:success AND method:DELETE AND host:${host:raw} AND account:${account:raw} AND container:${container:raw} AND NOT host:knu-tst1

panels.title: Failure 수
panels.description: 선택한 범위에서 실패한 object sync 이벤트 수

targets.query: event_type:container_sync_object AND outcome:failure AND host:${host:raw} AND account:${account:raw} AND container:${container:raw} AND NOT host:knu-tst1

panels.title: 노드별 PUT 처리량
panels.description: 어느 노드가 PUT을 많이 처리하는지 시간 흐름으로 확인

targets.query: event_type:container_sync_object AND outcome:success AND method:PUT AND host:${host:raw} AND account:${account:raw} AND container:${container:raw} AND NOT host:knu-tst1

panels.title: 노드별 DELETE 처리량
panels.description: DELETE 급증이나 특정 노드 편차를 확인

targets.query: event_type:container_sync_object AND outcome:success AND method:DELETE AND host:${host:raw} AND account:${account:raw} AND container:${container:raw} AND NOT host:knu-tst1

panels.title: 노드별 Sync 지연 시간(ms)
panels.description: 노드별 object 처리 평균 지연 시간

targets.query: event_type:container_sync_object AND host:${host:raw} AND account:${account:raw} AND container:${container:raw} AND NOT host:knu-tst1

panels.title: Account별 PUT/DELETE 처리량
panels.description: 선택한 host/container 범위에서 이벤트 수가 많은 account의 PUT/DELETE 성공 수 변화를 시계열로 확인. Legend는 account + method 조합으로 표시.

targets.query: event_type:container_sync_object AND outcome:success AND host:${host:raw} AND account:${account:raw} AND container:${container:raw} AND NOT host:knu-tst1

panels.title: Failure 원인별 추이
panels.description: 선택한 Node/Account/Container 범위에서 failure 원인이 시간에 따라 어떻게 늘어나는지 확인.

targets.query: event_type:container_sync_object AND outcome:failure AND host:${host:raw} AND account:${account:raw} AND container:${container:raw} AND NOT host:knu-tst1

panels.title: 노드별 Failure 원인
panels.description: 선택한 Node/Account/Container 범위에서 failure가 많이 발생한 노드와 원인을 집계해서 확인. 시간 흐름은 Failure 원인별 추이 패널에서 확인.

targets.query: event_type:container_sync_object AND outcome:failure AND host:${host:raw} AND account:${account:raw} AND container:${container:raw} AND NOT host:knu-tst1

panels.title: 컨테이너별 PUT 처리량
panels.description: 선택한 host/account 범위에서 PUT 이벤트 수가 많은 container를 시계열로 확인. Legend는 container + host 조합으로 표시.

targets.query: event_type:container_sync_object AND outcome:success AND method:PUT AND host:${host:raw} AND account:${account:raw} AND container:${container:raw} AND NOT host:knu-tst1

panels.title: 컨테이너별 DELETE 처리량
panels.description: 선택한 host/account 범위에서 DELETE 이벤트 수가 많은 container를 시계열로 확인. Legend는 container + host 조합으로 표시.

targets.query: event_type:container_sync_object AND outcome:success AND method:DELETE AND host:${host:raw} AND account:${account:raw} AND container:${container:raw} AND NOT host:knu-tst1

panels.title: 컨테이너별 Progress
panels.description: 선택한 Node/Account 범위에서 report 이벤트가 많은 container의 progress_percent 변화를 확인. Legend는 container 기준으로 표시.

targets.query: event_type:container_sync_report AND host:${host:raw} AND account:${account:raw} AND container:${container:raw} AND NOT host:knu-tst1

panels.title: 컨테이너 Row 현황
panels.description: 최근 container_sync_report 기준 row 처리 상태. 상세 이력은 Web/object search 쪽에서 drill-down.

targets.query: event_type:container_sync_report AND host:${host:raw} AND account:${account:raw} AND container:${container:raw} AND NOT host:knu-tst1

panels.title: 진행 중/실패 컨테이너
panels.description: started 이후 종료되지 않았거나 실패한 container 확인

targets.query: event_type:container_sync_state AND (state:started OR state:failed) AND host:${host:raw} AND account:${account:raw} AND container:${container:raw} AND NOT host:knu-tst1
